correctness.rationale: Exact row norm ‖g_z‖=1/(|z|sqrt(2Re z-1)); Bernstein E2 maps to Re z>=7a/8 for each a=2^j, yielding uniform Banach-analytic norm <=16/(7sqrt3)a^-3/2. Chebyshev truncation error <=4M a^-3/2 2^-J; squared Hilbert-Schmidt row sums across J blocks <=(4/3)(4M)^2 4^-J. Omitted tail <=(3/2)4^-J. Sum of square roots is 128/21+sqrt(3/2)<8. Rank <=J^2, so the min-max approximation number gives the claimed stretched-exponential singular bound. Finite tests supplement but do not prove the norm estimate.

value.rationale: The first public 2024 analysis explicitly raises moderate-versus-severe ill-posedness for this compact composition as a substantive open question; an explicit superpolynomial upper bound settles this dichotomy. The construction is uniform, quantitative, dimension-free and uses an operator-theoretic dyadic low-rank principle that addresses misleading finite-section numerics, rather than a routine trace or normalization identity.
